evidence: Unresolved: derives an indexed address from x0 low byte and a clamped x1 index (main_0057.c:52263-52285), reads one byte at record+0xc, calls attribute_context_status_value_get with property id 0x61, then performs further float conversion/clamping through f_70018c1360 (52286-52307). Caller handle_live_games_more_info passes x0/x1/x2 (main_0057.c:46930-46933), but neither the record identity nor returned float meaning is established; retain generated name.

Checks an enabled byte at x0+0x428; when enabled and x1 is valid, reads a nested provider pointer at x1+8, calls nested_attribute_provider_get_float with selector 0x16, converts the returned float to signed integer, and returns integer+1 (main_0116.c:9943-9955). Null-provider fallback performs the same selector lookup via f_700183f6e4 then returns int+1 (9964-9971). Callers pass x0 and x1 as record/provider candidates and x2 as fallback status (main_0116.c:1683-1687; main_0116.c:1660-1664).

Checks enabled byte x0+0x428 and a nonnull x1 provider pointer at +8, reads player_attribute_get_float(x1, selector 0), then maps the numeric result to fixed outputs 0, 15, 50, 75, 150, or 300 by comparisons at 15, 49, 74, 149, and 299 (main_0112.c:34587-34633). Caller supplies x0 and x1 and stores returned x0 as a 32-bit result (main_0112.c:5019-5023). Name describes observed threshold bucketing without assigning domain meaning to the buckets.

Requires enabled byte at x0+0x428; for valid x1 reads its nested pointer at +8, calls nested_attribute_provider_get_float with selector 0x16, converts to integer and classifies the integer into return codes 0-3 using thresholds 4, 10, and 20 (main_0119.c:9619-9650). Callers pass x0/x1 and a third-argument fallback/status value, then consume x0 as a 32-bit result (main_0119.c:9299-9303; main_0119.c:14128-14132).

For nonnull x1, calls convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 using x1 and the incoming x2 value (main_0112.c:38931-38942). It compares the resulting float against 0, 0.6, 0.8, and 0.9 and returns a small category code 0-5 based on those ranges (38939-38976). Caller passes x0, x1, x2=0 and stores the returned x0 (main_0112.c:34171-34175).
